title: David and Goliath
subtitle: 1 Samuel 17
intro: A shepherd boy. A giant. And a God who chose the boy.
outro: Type AMEN if you believe. Subscribe for a new story tomorrow.

shots.name: The Valley of Elah
shots.label: 1 Samuel 17:3
shots.line: Two armies. Forty days of silence.
shots.line_voice: For forty days, two armies stood across the Valley of Elah. Nobody moved.
shots.prompt: ancient Israelite army in bronze helmets standing on a rocky hillside at dusk, facing a wide dry valley, Philistine camp with torches on the far ridge, biblical epic

shots.name: Goliath
shots.label: 1 Samuel 17:4
shots.line: Nine feet tall. Bronze armor. The same challenge every morning.
shots.line_voice: Goliath. Nine feet tall, in bronze armor. Every morning he roared the same challenge.
shots.prompt: a colossal Philistine warrior in bronze scale armor and a bronze helmet, holding a massive spear, shouting across a valley, low angle, storm clouds, biblical epic

shots.name: David
shots.label: 1 Samuel 17:40
shots.line: A shepherd. No armor. A sling and five stones.
shots.line_voice: David. A shepherd boy. He refused the armor and took a sling and five smooth stones from the stream.
shots.prompt: a young shepherd boy with curly hair in a simple wool tunic kneeling at a clear stream, picking smooth stones, sling on his belt, warm morning light, biblical epic

shots.name: The Stone
shots.label: 1 Samuel 17:49
shots.line_voice: He ran toward the giant. One stone. One throw. It struck Goliath on the forehead.
shots.prompt: a young shepherd whirling a leather sling above his head, running across a dry valley toward a giant armored warrior, dust in the air, dramatic sunlight, biblical epic

shots.name: The Fall
shots.label: 1 Samuel 17:50
shots.line: The giant fell face down. The valley went silent.
shots.line_voice: The giant fell face down. And the whole valley went silent.
shots.prompt: a colossal bronze-armored warrior collapsing face-first onto dry ground, helmet rolling away, a small shepherd boy standing in the distance, golden dust, biblical epic
